how: We read the website of every Austin wedding planner listed on Lazo (77 listings, 61 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues and rental companies that also sell coordination, a caterer with a coordination line, a decor and mandap rental studio, an officiant, multi-service franchises, and a St. Louis planner listed in Austin. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which Hill Country venues and Austin vendors have you worked with this year, and how do you plan around heat and sudden storms at an outdoor site?
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate?

picks.name: Wedding Day Girl - Day of Coordinators
picks.blurb: Wedding Day Girl describes itself as straightforward, honest, luxury wedding coordinators, specializing in day-of services along with decoration and styling. The team says it is always clear about limitations or challenges it sees ahead of your day and works to protect the relationships you have built with your vendors.

picks.name: Moments and Milestones Wedding Planning and Coordination
picks.blurb: Moments and Milestones plans Hill Country and Central Texas weddings from Georgetown and limits the number of events it takes on each month so each couple gets focused attention. The team handles the day from first consultation to grand send-off.

picks.name: Weddings By Wendi
picks.blurb: Weddings by Wendi offers luxury planning and day-of coordination in Austin and the Hill Country, with 15-plus years of experience and more than 300 weddings planned. Wendi's path started with planning weddings for family and friends, and the site lays out two services for different needs plus a free consultation. Based in San Marcos.

picks.name: Glitzzy Events LLC
picks.blurb: Glitzzy Events took off in 2010 and has contributed to more than 280 events, and in recent years has focused on wedding planning for Indian, Indian-American and destination weddings. The Austin team offers a full range of planning and coordination services for Indian and fusion weddings.

picks.name: Events by ASM
picks.blurb: Events by ASM takes one wedding a weekend and 30 weddings a year, so each couple has its full attention. The Dripping Springs planner customizes weddings within your budget, and its coordination package for couples who have planned the rest includes unlimited calls, texts and emails.

picks.name: GCL Events
picks.blurb: GCL Events is an Austin wedding coordinator for couples who have most of the planning done: the signature package takes over at 60 days out and makes sure everything is in place for the day. The owner describes bringing creativity, precision and passion to weddings across Central Texas.

picks.name: MSJ Event- Indian wedding planner and decorator
picks.blurb: MSJ Event is an Austin planning and decor brand for Indian weddings, receptions and pre-wedding events, handling design and management from concept to execution. The team pairs planning with bespoke decor, from consultation and concept design to the finished room.

picks.name: WHITT ROSS
picks.blurb: WHITT ROSS is an Austin team of experienced planners and designers with distinct styles and a shared commitment to client-led design, listening first and designing second. They plan weddings and social celebrations with a clear point of view, whether deeply involved from day one or stepping in strategically when it counts.

picks.name: Party Fascinations
picks.blurb: Party Fascinations provides full-service wedding and event coordinating in Austin, from consulting to day-of directing, and also plans wedding-related parties and destination weddings. The team also works quinceaneras and corporate events, so ask for wedding references specifically.

picks.name: Ashley Nicole Affair
picks.blurb: Ashley Nicole Affair is a team of Austin wedding planners that takes a limited number of weddings per year for quality and consistency. The team page introduces multilingual and bilingual planners, the portfolio covers Texas and New Mexico weddings, and content creation is offered alongside planning.

picks.name: Austin Wedding Planners
picks.blurb: Austin Wedding Planners is Rosa Gibson's planning service for the greater Austin area. The site is built around couples' own accounts, including out-of-state couples and recent transplants who worked with Rosa and her team for a year and more to bring their wedding together.
